title: RF Expert & Test Engineer
desc:
We are the catalyst for the industrial world’s digital transformation.
For more than 35 years, ground breaking technologies and business models engineered and developed by Siemens Turkey R&D department contributes to the global success of Siemens
Our R&D activities focused on the fields of electrification, automation and digitalization, provides end-to-end support to our global customers on their unique digital transformation journey.
We aim to increase our strength on solution and product development with world class SW development experts, with the vision to be the digitalization partner for our global customers.
We need game changers like you, to bring the next level of smart manufacturing and infrastructure from mere concept to reality, develop tomorrow’s smart cities, and address the most critical digitalization challenges across a comprehensive range of industries.
What are my responsibilities?
RF validation and test activities for radio unit development for industrial communication networks and private 5G solutions,
Planning and executing test campaigns for validation of radio characteristics (e.g., transmitter power, spurious emissions, frequency stability, RF exposure) against regulatory standards such as FCC, ETSI, and 3GPP
Taking part in the complete product life-cycle, from requirements definition through pre-compliance testing to final certification
Contribution to solutions required for related standards, requirements elicitation and development processes improvement
Coordinating with accredited test labs and certification bodies to support regulatory submissions and product approvals
Producing high quality project deliverables, including test plans, reports, and certification documentation, within planned time and effort
Collaborate with international and cross-functional teams throughout the complete product lifecycle
Conforming to Siemens processes, quality standards, and guidelines
What do I need to qualify for this job?
BSc., MSc. Or PhD in Electronics, Telecommunication Engineering, Computer Science or related areas
Proven 5+ years of experience in RF engineering, testing, or validation
Hands-on experience with RF test equipment (spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers, signal generators, EMC/EMI chambers) is a must
Experience in development or validation of RF products for new generation wireless communication technologies (e.g., WiMax, 4G, 5G, Wi-Fi 6/7, cellular IoT)
Solid knowledge of regulatory standards and certification processes, particularly FCC, and familiarity with ETSI or other regional equivalents is a big plus
Very good command of English
Knowledge in software life cycle, test automation, and agile methodologies is appreciated
Excellent interpersonal communication skills
Strong problem solving and analytical skills
Open minded and highly collaborative
No restriction for travelling
What We Offer?
Speaking up Culture
Respectful Workplace
Being part of a global work environment
Attractive remuneration package
Excellent recognition tools providing spot awards
Learning & Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth
Leave days for parents and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family
Creche allowance for mothers
Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG
Remote working and remote living flexibility only for relevant positions
